from datetime import datetime, timedelta

day = datetime.strptime(run_date, "%Y-%m-%d")

# The time in a file name is the END of the hour.
# Hour 0 of this day ends at 01:00, ... hour 23 ends at 00:00 of the next day.
files = []
for h in range(1, 25):
    end = day + timedelta(hours=h)
    files.append(
        f"{bronze_path}/year={end:%Y}/month={end:%m}/day={end:%d}/"
        f"pageviews-{end:%Y%m%d-%H}0000.gz"
    )

print("Number of files:", len(files))
print("First:", files[0])
print("Last: ", files[-1])

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

raw = (
    spark.read.text(files)
    .withColumn("source_file", F.input_file_name())
)

raw.printSchema()
raw.show(5, truncate=False)

parts = F.split(F.col("value"), " ")

# File END time, e.g. "20260928-19" from ...pageviews-20260928-190000.gz
end_str = F.regexp_extract("source_file", r"pageviews-(\d{8}-\d{2})0000\.gz", 1)
end_ts = F.to_timestamp(end_str, "yyyyMMdd-HH")

# The hour STARTS one hour before the file time
start_ts = (F.unix_timestamp(end_ts) - 3600).cast("timestamp")

parsed = raw.select(
    F.col("value").alias("raw_line"),
    F.size(parts).alias("n_fields"),
    parts.getItem(0).alias("domain_code"),
    parts.getItem(1).alias("page_title"),
    parts.getItem(2).cast("long").alias("views"),
    F.to_date(start_ts).alias("view_date"),
    F.hour(start_ts).alias("view_hour"),
    "source_file",
)

parsed.drop("raw_line", "source_file").show(5, truncate=False)

scope = ["en", "en.m"]   

english = (
    parsed
    .filter(F.col("domain_code").isin(scope))
    .withColumn("language", F.split("domain_code", r"\.").getItem(0))
    .withColumn(
        "access",
        F.when(F.col("domain_code").endswith(".m"), "mobile").otherwise("desktop"),
    )
)

english.groupBy("domain_code", "language", "access").count().show()

reason = (
    F.when(F.col("n_fields") != 4, "wrong number of fields")
     .when(F.col("page_title").isNull() | (F.col("page_title") == ""), "empty title")
     .when(F.col("views").isNull(), "views not a number")
     .when(F.col("views") <= 0, "views zero or less")
)

checked = english.withColumn("reason", reason)

good = checked.filter(F.col("reason").isNull()).drop("reason", "n_fields", "raw_line")
bad  = checked.filter(F.col("reason").isNotNull())

checked.groupBy("reason").count().show(truncate=False)

namespaces = [
    "Special", "Talk", "User", "User_talk", "Wikipedia", "Wikipedia_talk",
    "File", "File_talk", "MediaWiki", "Template", "Template_talk",
    "Help", "Help_talk", "Category", "Category_talk", "Portal",
    "Draft", "Module", "TimedText",
]
ns_pattern = r"^(" + "|".join(namespaces) + r"):"

flagged = good.withColumn(
    "is_article",
    ~(
        F.col("page_title").rlike(ns_pattern)
        | F.col("page_title").isin("Main_Page", "-")
    ),
)

(
    flagged.groupBy("page_title", "is_article")
    .agg(F.sum("views").alias("views"))
    .orderBy(F.desc("views"))
    .show(20, truncate=False)

silver_df = (
    flagged
    .select("view_date", "view_hour", "domain_code", "language", "access",
            "page_title", "views", "is_article", "source_file")
    .withColumn("loaded_at", F.current_timestamp())
)

(
    silver_df.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("replaceWhere", f"view_date = '{run_date}'")
    .partitionBy("view_date")
    .save(silver_path)
)

quarantine_df = (
    bad
    .select("view_date", "view_hour", "source_file", "raw_line", "reason")
    .withColumn("loaded_at", F.current_timestamp())
)

(
    quarantine_df.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("replaceWhere", f"view_date = '{run_date}'")
    .partitionBy("view_date")
    .save(quarantine_path)
)

print("Done")

# 1. From the raw files (one pass over all 24 files)
totals = parsed.agg(
    F.count("*").alias("raw"),
    F.sum(F.col("domain_code").isin(scope).cast("int")).alias("english"),
).first()

# 2. From what was saved
silver_saved = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_path).filter(F.col("view_date") == run_date)
quar_saved   = spark.read.format("delta").load(quarantine_path).filter(F.col("view_date") == run_date)

n_silver = silver_saved.count()
n_quar   = quar_saved.count()
n_hours  = silver_saved.select("view_hour").distinct().count()

print("Raw rows:            ", totals["raw"])
print("English rows:        ", totals["english"])
print("Out of scope rows:   ", totals["raw"] - totals["english"])
print("Silver rows:         ", n_silver)
print("Quarantine rows:     ", n_quar)
print("Hours in silver:     ", n_hours)
print("English = silver + quarantine:", totals["english"] == n_silver + n_quar)

log_path = f"abfss://gold@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/ops_run_log"

# 1. Run the checks, and collect any problems
english = totals["english"]
quarantine_share = n_quar / english if english else 1.0

problems = []
if english == 0:
    problems.append("no English rows")
if n_hours != 24:
    problems.append(f"only {n_hours} of 24 hours")
if english != n_silver + n_quar:
    problems.append("row counts do not add up")
if quarantine_share > 0.01:
    problems.append(f"quarantine share is {quarantine_share:.2%}")

status = "OK" if not problems else "FAILED: " + "; ".join(problems)

# 2. Write the log row (also when checks fail, so the failure is recorded)
log_row = spark.createDataFrame(
    [(run_date, pipeline_run_id,
      int(totals["raw"]), int(english),
      int(n_silver), int(n_quar), int(n_hours), status)],
    "run_date string, pipeline_run_id string, raw_rows long, english_rows long, "
    "silver_rows long, quarantine_rows long, hours_found int, status string",
).withColumn("logged_at", F.current_timestamp())

log_row.write.format("delta").mode("append").save(log_path)

# 3. Stop the notebook if any check failed
if problems:
    raise Exception(f"Silver checks failed for {run_date}: {status}")

print("All silver checks passed")
